en.name: Warrior Assault Systems DCS plate carrier (Assault, Multicam)
en.description: A Full-coverage plate carrier built for heavy assaults and sustained firefights. The DCS in Assault configuration comes loaded with integrated mag pouches, admin storage, and kevlar arm protection, offering excellent balance between armor coverage and load-carrying capacity. Multicam version.

en.name: 6B45 body armor (EMR)
en.description: The 6B45 Body Armor is a modular body armor issued to RUAF frontline troops. The armor has soft inserts with the capability to use any standard Granit ballistic plate. This armor was developed as part of the Ratnik Soldier Modernisation program for the Russian Armed Forces (RUAF)

en.name: Warrior Assault Systems DCS plate carrier (Full, A-TACS FG)
en.description: A Full-coverage plate carrier built for heavy assaults and sustained firefights. The DCS in the Full configuration comes loaded with integrated mag pouches, admin storage, and kevlar groin and arm protection, offering optimal armor coverage for breachers or other high-risk roles. A-TACS Foliage Green version.
